successors.text: 'much of the highlands of the northern Spanish Atlantic coast', 'the whole of modern Cantabria province', eastern Asturias and parts of Palencia, Burgos and León; the disc cuts the provinces to the…

ledger.x: The Cantabri of the northern Spanish mountains.
19 BC: 'The major fighting was completed in 19 BC.'
19 BC: the Cantabri land is Roman.
19 BC: Cantabrian independence ends; the region is a province, with 'a form of local self-rule' granted in the early 1st century AD.

wars.name: Cantabrian Wars
wars.outcome: Roman victory under Augustus and Agrippa: Cantabria, Asturias and Gallaecia came under Roman control as part of Hispania; the Cantabri were largely annihilated.

certainty.note: Mountain country with tribal limits; no boundary line is given by either page.
